openapi.title: Open platform
openapi.description: Manage app credentials, event webhooks and delivery logs exposed to third parties

apps.resetConfirm: The current AppSecret of "{{name}}" stops working immediately and callers must update their config. Continue?
apps.deleteConfirm: Delete app "{{name}}"? Its callers will lose access immediately.

form.nameTooLong: Name must be 50 characters or fewer
form.descTooLong: Description must be 200 characters or fewer
form.rolesHint: The app gets the union of the selected roles' permissions when calling APIs; with no roles it has no permissions.
form.ipHint: One IPv4 / IPv6 address or CIDR per line, e.g. 203.0.113.10 or 10.0.0.0/8. Leave empty to allow any source IP.
form.ipInvalid: Not a valid IP or CIDR: {{ip}}

secret.title: App created — save the secret
secret.onceHint: The AppSecret is shown only once. You will not be able to view it again after leaving; if lost, reset it.

guide.title: Integration guide
guide.hint: Every open API request must carry the headers below so the server can verify identity and prevent replay.

header.X-Timestamp: Request time in Unix seconds; must be within ±5 minutes of server time
header.X-Nonce: A random string unique per request; reuse is rejected

guide.stringToSign: String to sign (joined by newline \n; query is the raw query string without ?, empty if none; body is the raw request body):
guide.algorithm: Signature = HMAC-SHA256(AppSecret, stringToSign), output as lowercase hex.
guide.window: The time window is ±5 minutes; requests outside it or with a repeated nonce are rejected.

webhooks.resetConfirm: The current signing secret of "{{name}}" stops working immediately and the receiver must be updated. Continue?
webhooks.deleteConfirm: Delete webhook "{{name}}"? Events will no longer be pushed.

form.nameTooLong: Name must be 50 characters or fewer
form.urlHint: Must be an https URL; http://localhost is allowed for development.
form.urlInvalid: Enter an https URL (http://localhost allowed for development)

secret.title: Webhook created — save the signing secret
secret.onceHint: The signing secret is shown only once. You will not be able to view it again after leaving; if lost, reset it.
secret.usage: Every delivery carries a signature computed with this secret. Receivers should verify it before handling the event.

docs.notCallable: This endpoint cannot be called with this credential.

deliveries.truncated: The response is long; only the first {{count}} characters are shown.
